messages.subject: Between-group comparisons
parts:
Hi, 

I have fitted a model with data which may belong to two different groups. 
If I were to fit two different models, group comparisons between parameters would be straightforward (same as here https://ccs-lab.github.io/hBayesDM/articles/getting_started.html#compare-models-and-groups).
Since I only have one model, what would be the correct way to test for group differences? 
Selecting the samples belonging to the two different groups and compare them?

Thanks for your help!
Filippo

messages.author: cf19ade26e5385d2
messages.subject: Re: Between-group comparisons
parts:
Hi Filippo,

Sorry for the long delay.

You need to fit each group with the same model and ideally the same number of MCMC samples in order to test group differences.
Please check this instruction (https://ccs-lab.github.io/hBayesDM/articles/getting_started.html#compare-models-and-groups) for more information.

Best,
Eunhwi
